Our Work

Four pillars. One ecosystem.

GPS generates knowledge, builds capacity, drives implementation, convenes actors, and mobilises partnerships — through four pillars that feed each other in every direction.

Pillar 01

Knowledge Co-Creation, Sharing & Dissemination

Research, universities, knowledge networks, publications, training, and fellowships — the South generating its own evidence and ideas.

Feeds every pillar
Pillar 02

Technology & Innovation

AI, digital transformation, innovation labs, entrepreneurship, smart agriculture, and health innovation — research becoming practical solutions.

Connects research to solutions
Pillar 03

Policy, Governance & Public Leadership

Public policy, governance, diplomacy, policy advisory, and leadership dialogues — knowledge and innovation reaching policymaking.

Turns evidence into decisions
Pillar 04

Enterprise & Sustainable Development

Private sector, industry, start-ups, investment, business partnerships, and executive education — enterprise connected to knowledge and impact.

Carries knowledge to market
The connections are the point

Interconnected, never linear.

Knowledge can influence policy; policy can stimulate innovation; enterprise can generate new knowledge; communities can identify challenges that drive research. Hover the diagram.

Where it all leads

Impact & Social Transformation

Six domains, four pillars

Where the core domains live.

GPS operates through six interconnected core domains. Each finds its home across the pillars — most span more than one, which is exactly the point.

Core domainWhat it coversPrimary pillars
Education, Training & ResearchLeadership formation, professional development, learning systems, knowledge productionKnowledge
Technology & InnovationAI & digital transformation, innovation labs, data systems, foresight toolsInnovation
Economy & SocietyInclusive growth, entrepreneurship, green economies, food systems, tradeEnterprise
Creative ProductionArts, literature, film, cultural industries, memory and narrativesKnowledge Innovation
Cooperation, Finance & SustainabilityPartnerships, development finance, philanthropy, resource mobilizationEnterprise Policy
Convening & DialogueSummits, policy forums, Kigali Knowledge Crossroads Week, public engagementPolicy All pillars
